title: Existence of the characterized second localization map
statement: For the rings and models of lem-pc-second-localization-iso, the canonical characterized coefficient map exists as a morphism between the two extended cohomology modules.

proof.text: The cohomology comparison defined in SecondLocalizationMap commutes with multiplication by A: conjugate by the model cohomology isomorphisms, use naturality of flatDerivedHomologyIso and secondLocalizationDerivedMap, and transpose the naturality square through scalar-extension adjunction. B-linearity is built into that comparison. Tensor induction then proves semilinearity over the map A tensor_R B to A tensor_R Bp.

Regard this semilinear comparison as a morphism to the restriction of scalars from A tensor_R Bp and take its scalar-extension adjoint. The two maps from A tensor_R B to D agree, by tensor induction and the scalar-tower hypotheses. Compose the resulting equality transport, extendScalarsComp associator, and further extension to D of the adjoint. The associator formula on 1 tensor x and the adjunction generator formula prove IsSecondLocalizationMap. Reuse the existing private RingTensorCohomology.extendScalars_eqToIso_one_tmul from FirstLocalizationMap (via a proof-only import all) for transport of the generator along the equality of coefficient maps; do not prove a duplicate transport lemma.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0DJ8 and 06Y6; complete Lean proof by naturality of the derived comparison and flat homology isomorphism, scalar-extension adjunction, tensor induction, and the scalar-extension associator. No K-flat resolution or counit invertibility is used for existence. Official Stacks pages read online by the first worker because this remote clone omits the literature sources. Repair of the duplicate-helper return: coefficient-map transport now reuses FirstLocalizationMap rather than declaring the same lemma again.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_secondLocalization_hom
    (T : Submonoid B) [IsLocalization T Bp] (hflat : (algebraMap B Bp).Flat) (i : ℤ)
    (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (L : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q D)
    (K : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A Bp Q D) :
    ∃ f : (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D)).obj (L.cohomology i) ⟶
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] Bp) D)).obj (K.cohomology i),
      IsSecondLocalizationMap R A B Bp D hflat Q L K i f
